title: iOS decimal keypad may block negative numbers and comma-locale input
evidence: Suspected, not verified on a device: inputMode="decimal" (required by ADR 0005 and the task) shows the iOS decimal pad, which has no minus key, and in comma-decimal locales it offers ',' which parseOperand rejects by design. Reported by the task 3 reviewer from platform knowledge; no iPhone was available.
impact: Some iPhone users may be unable to type negative operands or decimals with the on-screen keypad.
precautions: Verify on a real iOS device before changing anything; inputMode and the dot-only rule are spec decisions (ADR 0005, spec feature 4), so a change needs a spec or ADR update first.
